title: Mystery Orbs Are Back Over Cody, And UFO Expert Can't Explain Them
description: A Cody man watched nearly two dozen glowing orbs rise over Cedar Mountain west of town every night last winter. Then they vanished for months. Now they're back, and Wyoming's Mutual UFO Network director says he has no explanation for the video.
